build.prompt: For non-trivial tasks, first use @architect-c or @architect-g to draft an implementation plan or sketch, then dispatch @general-c or @general-g subagents to implement and verify the result. Have another subagent review the work before considering the task complete.

general-c.description: General-purpose subagent (Sonnet). Similarly capable to @general-g; for important tasks, ask both and aim for consensus, or have one review the other's output.

general-g.description: General-purpose subagent (Gemini Flash). Similarly capable to @general-c; for important tasks, ask both and aim for consensus, or have one review the other's output.

architect-c.description: Architect for hard problems: planning, design, complex debugging, architectural decisions, tricky refactors. Also consider asking @architect-g and aiming for consensus.

architect-g.description: Architect for hard problems: planning, design, complex debugging, architectural decisions, tricky refactors. Also consider asking @architect-c and aiming for consensus.
